references.text: Introduces the Levite and his concubine, who are the main characters in this story
Describes the arrival at Gibeah in Benjamin, the place mentioned in verse 20:4
Tells of the horrific act against the concubine that led to her death
The Levite sends parts of his concubine's body to all the tribes of Israel to call them to action
The assembly of Israel gathers at Mizpah to hear the Levite's testimony
Mentions Gibeah as a place of sin in Israel's history
Hosea refers to the days of Gibeah as a symbol of Israel's sin
Another reference to Gibeah as a place of sin and rebellion
